name: shreeram-daily-milk
description: Monorepo root. apps/mobile is deliberately NOT a workspace member — see docs/web-admin.md ('Deliberately not shared') for why it stays on its own independent install, decoupled from Expo/Metro's expectations. This root exists only so apps/web and packages/shared share hoisted node_modules (so packages/shared's own dependencies, e.g. zod, resolve when apps/web's bundler pulls in packages/shared/src/**) — never run `npm install` here expecting it to touch apps/mobile.
